effect_sizes.name: phase-embedded KLD vs AAFT-surrogate null (nats/hour)
effect_sizes.method: re-embedded AAFT surrogate null (band = the NULL, not the estimate)

n_justification: 4032 RTM intervals over 14 days at node TH_SP15_GEN-APND; the FT-surrogate null shares the spectrum (persistence and the diurnal peak) and the plug-in bias at exactly this n, so a detection verdict is bias- and persistence-robust; the value-space reading is the built-in blindness control (a periodic drive retraces its 1-D path, so value discretization must sit on its null).
notes: Detection flags are FINDINGS, not gate criteria. embed_detected=1 requires exceeding BOTH the FT and AAFT null upper quantiles. null_mismatch_low=1 means the reading escapes the AAFT null band on the LOW side: neither detection nor a sharp certified null -- the surrogate class fails to bracket the data's Δ-sign persistence, and the honest verdict is 'no detection; adequate null construction open' (F-0008 as revised per red-team review).
